name: 会話内で共有する動画リンク
prompt:
Revise the first image of a Discord video-link preview card. Owner feedback: the linked title and category text must be BLUE because they communicate hyperlinks. Use accessible clear link blue #007AFF for BOTH the Japanese title and category/link-tag row. Keep the provider label gray. Keep the exact Japanese strings.

Use native reference 2 to correct the oversized white space above and below the card in image 1. Output a canvas exactly 390x326 ratio. Card face at x68 y8, width306 height304, radius8. Forest accent stripe at x64 y8 width3 height304. Card right edge374, bottom312. Avoid centering a smaller card. The card should fill nearly the whole height and width as specified.
Text coordinates on the canvas: provider 動画の共有, x80 y18, Meiryo Regular12/16 gray #6E6E6E; title 地域の活動を伝える工夫, x80 y44, Meiryo Bold14/24, hyperlink blue #007AFF; category 発信のアイデア・交流・地域の活動, x80 y74, Meiryo Regular12/16 hyperlink blue #007AFF. No other text, no line wraps, no random bold, tracking0.
Preserve the exact source video's thumbnail content and arrangement from reference 3 and candidate 1. Keep it at x80 y112, width282, height186 (aspect 1.516), rounded8. The last version's card was too short and started near y38 instead of y8; enlarge/raise the card to the specified bounds and text positions. Thumbnail proportions in v002 are closer; preserve them. Keep its central narrow vertical short, black letterbox, dark playback strip, play circle, white triangle and red handwriting on phone/video scene. Do not replace with generic imagery.
Use restrained native light-neutral background #F4F4F5, forest stripe #057857, and preserve the original artwork colors. Do not add a frame around the entire 390x326 canvas, do not add margins, watermark, other controls, other links or icons. The title and category linked text must read as blue at first glance; provider alone remains gray.
reviewNotes: 3回目は動画タイトルとリンクカテゴリを青に修正し、投稿者はグレーを保持。日本語文言と緑の縦アクセントは読み取れる。カードと内容は正しいが、文字列と画像がネイティブ指定より左へ約26pxずれ、図版の細部も原画像の完全一致ではない。needs-correctionで保存し、位置/図版残差と所有者承認未確認を記録する。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
